objective: Prevent HF API saturation during multi-AI memory/version campaigns without dropping evidence or overwriting history.

scaling.eight_agents_per_ai: A6_MEMORY_KEEPER is the default persistent writer; other agents submit capsules to A6 rather than each writing independently.
scaling.twenty_agent_burst: Use one or a few MEMORY_KEEPER writers for the burst; 20 agents does not imply 20 simultaneous HF writers.
scaling.thirty_eight_ai_rollout: Batch by families; never start 38 concurrent HF writers.
